title: rut manifest (rut.jsonc)
description: A rut module manifest: the module's identity, its entry sources, and its dependency rows. The file is JSONC — `//` and `/* */` comments and trailing commas are legal. One directory is one module; the manifest is the directory's identity card. The root module is `src/mod.rut` (the package's `src/` shell; file modules: `mod NAME;` in the root declares each `src/NAME/mod.rut` child); the repealed `entry.lib`/`entry.libs` keys are refused — rename the lib to `src/mod.rut` and drop the keys.

name.description: The package name — what a `use` path spells (`use pouch::{ Vec }`). A bare package name: [a-zA-Z0-9_]+.

type.description: The package kind. `lib` is the ordinary rut package (a source body, deps allowed, no host rows). `host` is a pure declaration surface the embedding Rust binds at run time — no body, no deps of any kind. Absent means `lib`; a host package spells itself.

format.description: Marks a bundle-shaped manifest (`rut pack` needs the bundle keys; directory loading ignores them).

format_version.description: The bundle layout version — 13, the ONE wire this toolchain reads. A bundle stamped with any other version is refused on load (the refusal names the re-pack): re-pack the directory with the current toolchain; there is no compatibility ladder.

entry.description: Where the module's `.d.rut` declaration surface lives — relative to this manifest's directory, resolving under the `src/` shell. The body is `src/mod.rut` (the root module; `mod NAME;` declares each `src/NAME/mod.rut` child). The repealed `entry.lib`/`entry.libs` keys are refused — rename the lib to `src/mod.rut` and drop the keys.

type.description: The `.d.rut` declaration surface — the type half. Indexes in Decl mode.

deps.description: Transitively mounted dependencies: exact specifier → descriptor. Each descriptor names exactly ONE source — `path` (a module directory) or `url` (a remote artifact; the url's own extension routes the lane: `.zip` unpacks a source-zip transport — the lane the std set ships — anything else loads as a compiled `.rutbundle`); url rows are `{ "url": ... }` only, the `sha256` key is retired (pins live in the sibling `rut.lock` — the pin is law at the mount door).

propertyNames.description: A bare package name — the specifier a `use` path spells.

dev-deps.description: Dependencies mounted only while building/testing this package itself — never in a consumer's world. The root manifest's table only (a dep's own dev table is never walked). Each descriptor is `{ "path": ... }` — a directory relative to this manifest's directory; no flags, no url.

style.description: The package's formatter knobs — flat `"key": "value"` rows (e.g. `"indent": "2"`). Keys and values are validated by the `rut fmt` tool, never the loader; unknown keys ride.

depDescriptor.description: Exactly one source: a `path` directory or a `url` remote artifact (`.zip` source transport or `.rutbundle` compiled, routed by the url's own extension) — never both, never neither. Url rows are `{ "url": ... }` only — the `sha256` key is retired from the manifest grammar; pins live in the sibling `rut.lock` (run `rut install`).

path.description: The dependency's module directory, relative to this manifest's directory (may reach outside the workspace folder).

url.description: The remote artifact url (http/https) — the lane routes by the url's own spelling: `.zip` is the source-zip transport (the std lane ships source zips), anything else a compiled `.rutbundle`. The pin is law at the mount door and lives in the sibling `rut.lock` — the manifest's `sha256` key is retired ('sha256' retired — pins live in rut.lock).

devDescriptor.description: A dev descriptor: `path` is the one key — dev presence is name-based at the root, so the descriptor carries no flags and no url (a url there is refused at parse).

path.description: The dependency's module directory, relative to this manifest's directory.
